visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long black hair, wearing a black baseball cap with a white 'W' logo and a teal-and-black horizontally striped shirt, stands in a brightly lit toy store aisle. He holds up two Mattel Jurassic World 'Micro Adventures' toy packages, gesturing toward the camera. Behind him, shelves are filled with various red and white boxed toys, and blurred shoppers move in the distant background. (2) The camera transitions to a macro close-up of the T-Rex head packaging on a light-colored surface. A pair of hands enters the frame, peeling back the clear plastic covering. The man points to several tiny, detailed plastic dinosaur figurines, including an Ankylosaurus and a Pteranodon, resting near the large T-Rex head. (3) The man opens the hinged T-Rex head to reveal a miniature landscape inside. The interior features a blue plastic waterfall, a marshy green base with a white Triceratops skeleton, and rocky formations. His fingers demonstrate the movement of a small orange dinosaur placed within the scene. (4) The shot focuses on the exterior of the T-Rex head as the man repeatedly snaps the jaws shut with his hands, showing the interlocking yellow teeth and realistic skin texture. Yellow and white subtitles appear briefly at the bottom of the frame while the background remains a neutral indoor setting. (5) He unboxes the second set, featuring a Spinosaurus head with a narrower, more elongated snout. He holds up a tiny, brown-colored human figurine and a dark green Mosasaurus figure between his thumb and forefinger. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the small scale of the accessories. (6) The Spinosaurus head is opened, revealing a jungle and river scene with a blue water track. A small Spinosaurus figure is shown sliding along the track in the upper jaw section. The video ends with a side-by-side comparison of both closed dinosaur heads resting on the table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins a friendly greeting with a moderate pitch and high vocal arousal. The background music is a steady, upbeat electronic track with a prominent synth bassline and crisp electronic percussion. A faint indoor room tone is present. (2) A series of high-frequency crinkling sounds occur as plastic packaging is rustled and peeled back. The speaker's rate of speech increases as he describes the small dinosaur figures. (3) Sharp, mechanical clicking sounds with quick transients are heard as the toy dinosaur head is opened and closed repeatedly. The speaker's voice maintains a positive valence and clear articulation over the consistent BGM volume. (4) A percussive thudding sound occurs as the toys are placed down on a surface. The speaker chuckles slightly, introducing more variability in his pitch contour while discussing the 'human' figure. The BGM continues uninterrupted until the video's end.
